evidence.quote: The Computer Science (BSc) programme is offered entirely in German and begins with a two-semester introductory phase.

notes: The DAAD page supplies the programme's tuition, duration, teaching language, application route and German-language requirement; pages from the university website describe general procedures (some quotes there are about other programmes, e.g. Management in Nonprofit-Organisations and Internationale Betriebswirtschaft und Management, and were not used for programme facts). The university's international-documents page says foreign-diploma applicants apply through uni-assist; the DAAD page confirms 'Please apply via uni-assist' for this programme. A transcript of records is mentioned as a document on another programme's page, so it was not treated as a document for this programme.
